titleText: VAT inspections ground to a halt in election month, Finance Minister confirms
mainText: From Times of Malta: VAT inspections ground to a halt in election month, Finance Minister confirms. Zero inspections carried out in May and just 26 in April

titleText: Months of roadworks still ahead on key route into Three Cities
mainText: From Times of Malta: Months of roadworks still ahead on key route into Three Cities. Triq Għajn Dwieli has been subject to traffic diversions since September

titleText: VAT inspections stopped for election month
mainText: From MaltaToday: VAT inspections stopped for election month. No VAT inspections took place in May, the month of the general election, figures tabled in parliament by Finance Minister Clyde Caruana show. And in April, when the expectation of a general election was high, VAT inspections dropped to a mere 26.

titleText: Environment Minister highlights climate extremities following ‘very disappointing’ COP31
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Environment Minister highlights climate extremities following ‘very disappointing’ COP31. Environment Minister Miriam Dalli opened her speech in Parliament on Wednesday by listing several climate-related statistics that reached their highest levels on record this year in her first address following COP31.

titleText: Government to open call for Grand Harbour regeneration proposals, Energy Minister says
mainText: From MaltaToday: Government to open call for Grand Harbour regeneration proposals, Energy Minister says. The government is preparing a call for proposals to redevelop parts of Grand Harbour, Energy Minister Miriam Dalli has said on Wednesday.
